The rider's complaint is that the driver was not at the entrance where the pin was [F10]. The chat history is complete — 3 messages, all timestamped, none suggesting any threat or refusal to wait — so nothing displaces the timeline [F12][F11][NS-1].

Because all three NS-1 elements pass, the $6.61 cancellation fee is valid and is retained; the driver's wait and cancellation follow the published no-show procedure, so no refund arises and no account action is called for. The safety screen finds no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation in the chat, the rider's complaint or the driver's statement; it is a plain pickup-location dispute [F9][F10][F11][F13]. The record settles every element the ruling needs, so evidence is sufficient and no escalation is required [F2][F4][F6][F12][NS-1].
